rpcore.hud.editor.title: HUD editor
rpcore.hud.editor.hint: Drag with the mouse, wheel — size (Shift — 1 pixel), right click — hide or show, Shift+right click — icon only
rpcore.cmd.skills_managed: Skills are managed by RP Perks.
rpcore.cmd.skills_unmanaged: RP Perks is not installed — no skills, everything works as at max level.
rpcore.cmd.skill_progress: %s: skill %s — level %s (trained %s and %s %% to the next)
rpcore.cmd.food_managed: Hunger, thirst and weight are handled by RP Culinary.
rpcore.cmd.food_unmanaged: RP Culinary is not installed — vanilla hunger.
rpcore.cmd.commands_none: No commands (or none available to you)
rpcore.help.skill: show skill level and progress; set a level or add/remove (add 1 — a level, add 0.1 — 10 %%)
rpcore.help.rphud: HUD editor for all family mods
rpcore.help.rptime_sleep: skip time asleep (slower hunger, wounds heal); the world does not change. Last word: online — the selected players (also without a word), all — them and everyone offline, offline — only everyone offline
rpcore.help.rptime_skip: skip time awake; the world does not change. Last word — who: online, all or offline, as for sleep
rpcore.time.disabled: RP time is off: no RP Time and rptime.enabled = false in the Core config — time always runs.
rpcore.time.stopped: RP time is paused: the sun stands, hunger and wounds wait.
rpcore.time.bad_time: RP duration: 30m, 2h, 1h30m, 1d or a number of hours (a minute to 30 days)
rpcore.time.slept: Slept %s RP (≈%s real). It is %s, day %s. Players online: %s, offline: %s.
rpcore.help.profile: body profile: sex, age, height; reset lets the player fill it in again
rpcore.cmd.profile_body: Weight %s kg, fat %s %% — %s; normal blood ≈ %s ml
rpcore.cmd.profile_empty: profile not filled in — the player can fill it in
rpcore.hand.with_item: Empty hand: only with an item
rpcore.hand.item_and_action: Empty hand: with an item and during actions
rpcore.gm.no_rights: Only a game master can configure this
rpcore.gm.plate.title: Hidden Plate
rpcore.gm.plate.name: Name (arrival point)
rpcore.gm.holder.title: Item Holder
rpcore.help.point: Arrival points for the hidden plate: set — here with this view, remove, tp — go there, list — all.
rpcore.point.set: Point "%s" saved: here, with this view
rpcore.point.removed: Point "%s" removed (if it was set by command)
rpcore.point.taken: Name "%s" belongs to a block (%s) — pick another
flrender.technique.rpcore.eye_spheres.to: The Red Eyes effect: white-hot spheres with a halo, always facing the viewer. Off = flat glowing spots on the face (cheaper). With red_eyes_style = FLAT in rpcore-client.toml - always spots.
rpcore.help.taste: character tastes: favourite and disliked; reset — the player chooses again
rpcore.taste.invalid: Favourite and disliked must both be chosen and differ
item.rpcore.owner_tag.desc: Tag in the main hand, the item in the off hand, right-click: the item is signed with your name
item.rpcore.number_tag.desc: Tag in the main hand, the item in the off hand, right-click: the item gets a number
rpcore.mark.need_offhand: Hold the item in your off hand
rpcore.mark.need_mainhand: Hold the item in your main hand
rpcore.mark.has_owner: The item already has an owner — only a GM can change it
rpcore.mark.has_number: The item already has a number — only a GM can change it
rpcore.help.mark: marks on the held item: number (auto — the next world number) and owner; clear — remove
rpcore.posture.sat: You sit down. Stand up — Shift or jump; sleep — /sleep
rpcore.posture.lay: You lie down. Stand up — Shift or jump; sleep — /sleep
rpcore.posture.ground: You can't sit or lie here — solid ground needed
rpcore.posture.sleep_where: You can sleep sitting or lying: /sit, /lay or on a seat
rpcore.posture.wake_hint: You are asleep. Wake up — Shift or /sleep
rpcore.time.passed: %s RP passed (≈%s real). It is %s, day %s. Players online: %s, offline: %s.
rpcore.time.player_passed: Players: %s — %s RP passed (≈%s real), the sun stays.
rpcore.time.player_slept: Players: %s — slept %s RP (≈%s real), the sun stays.
rpcore.msg.character_wiped: Your character has been reset. Fill in the form and choose perks again.
rpcore.help.wipe: Reset a character: all mod data; items and PDA stay. If the player is offline, it happens on login.
rpcore.cmd.wipe_confirm: Character %s will be fully reset. To confirm, add confirm at the end of the command.
rpcore.cmd.wipe_pending: Character %s will be reset on login
